description: This file defines the interface IGeneratedEventReporterGrain in the TestGrainInterfaces namespace, which is part of a Orleans-based application. It specifies methods for reporting results, retrieving reports, resetting state, and checking silo location.

classes.name: IGeneratedEventReporterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for reporting and retrieving event data, and managing grain state.

methods.name: ReportResult
methods.description: Reports an event result with a stream GUID, provider, namespace, and an integer count.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Retrieves a report as a dictionary mapping stream GUIDs to counts, filtered by stream provider and namespace.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state of the grain.

methods.name: IsLocatedOnSilo
methods.description: Checks whether the grain is located on a specified silo address.
